messages:
elaine: Morning — quota dashboard shows service-account token usage ~35% lower than raw logs for a few tenants. anyone else seeing this?
omar: yeah, looks like edge proxy rotates/rewrites bearer tokens so our sampler (key-hash) treats same SA as many identities. undercounting.
kai: do we have traces demonstrating header rewriting vs effective id propagation?
omar: snippet:
``nedge: recv auth=sha256:foo -> forwarded auth=bearer proxy-sess-42
authsvc: introspect(proxy-sess-42) => sa=svc-77 effective_id=svc-77 verified=true
```
but sampler ran before introspect and keyed on `auth.hash`.
rachel: switching sampler to `effective_id` would fix attribution but requires auth lookup before sampling — might increase auth QPS and latency.
elaine: proposal: hybrid sampling. keep cheap pre-auth key-hash sampler at 1% for general traffic, add deterministic low-rate (0.1%) identity-sampled records when authsvc reports verified=true. only emit identity sample after verification.
kai: config draft:
``nauth.sampling.fast_rate=0.01
auth.sampling.identity.enabled=true
auth.sampling.identity.rate=0.001
auth.sampling.identity.key=verified_effective_id||api_key_id
```
oma: must include `billing_project` and `tenant_id` in identity samples for joinability; redact anything else.
rachel: ui: telemetry panel should show both counts and an expected-bias note. also show sampling FF state.
elaine: actions: (1) omar run 48h passive identity-only sampler (no downstream emit) to estimate collisions/coverage; (2) kai add feature-flag `auth.sampling.hybrid` and unit tests; (3) rachel mock console changes and tooltip copy.
authbot: Canary policy: feature flag must run >=2h with alert `telemetry.identity.delta > 20%`.
elaine: aiming for a small canary next week assuming omar's data looks good.
omar: will post stats by EOD today.
_meta: Slack thread about making sampled telemetry resilient to proxy token rotation; timestamp used for filename
